summary_1line: Bhishma explains origins of various mixed castes, their occupations and traits, and discusses how lineage, conduct, and types of sons are defined in dharmic law.

image_candidates.scene_text: Outcast families wearing iron ornaments build huts near a cremation ground at a crossroads while crafting utensils from scrap.
Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows speaking to Yudhishthira who stands respectfully listening on the battlefield.
A Chandala figure draped in garments taken from corpses walks among funeral pyres guarding the dead.
